name: year
description: Reference year of the survey period

name: cbsa_id
description: Five-digit Core Based Statistical Area code

name: csa_id
description: Three-digit Combined Statistical Area code the CBSA belongs to
observations: Null where the source publishes 999, meaning the CBSA is not part of a CSA

name: cbsa_type
description: Header code distinguishing metropolitan from micropolitan areas
observations: Published from January 2024 only, when micropolitan areas were added to the file. Null before that

name: full_monthly_coverage
description: Whether the area is completely covered by monthly reporting permit-issuing places
observations: Published up to 2023 only, in the field replaced by cbsa_type from January 2024. Null from 2024 on

name: structure_type
description: Type of residential structure, by the number of housing units in the building
observations: Census structure type codes: 101 single-family, 103 two-family, 104 three- and four-family, 105 five-or-more-family. Summing the four codes reproduces the published total for the geography

name: cbsa_name
description: Name of the Core Based Statistical Area, as published

name: buildings
description: Number of buildings authorized by building permits
observations: Estimate with imputation: reported data for responding permit offices plus imputed data for non-respondents. This is the series to use by default. Counted in buildings

name: units
description: Number of housing units authorized by building permits
observations: Estimate with imputation: reported data for responding permit offices plus imputed data for non-respondents. This is the series to use by default. Counted in housing units

name: valuation
description: Construction valuation of the buildings authorized, in US dollars
observations: Estimate with imputation: reported data for responding permit offices plus imputed data for non-respondents. This is the series to use by default

name: buildings_reported
description: Number of buildings authorized, counting reporting permit offices only
observations: Reported only: counts data from responding permit offices and makes no imputation for non-respondents. Lower than the estimate with imputation. Counted in buildings

name: units_reported
description: Number of housing units authorized, counting reporting permit offices only
observations: Reported only: counts data from responding permit offices and makes no imputation for non-respondents. Lower than the estimate with imputation. Counted in housing units

name: valuation_reported
description: Construction valuation of the buildings authorized, in US dollars, counting reporting permit offices only
observations: Reported only: counts data from responding permit offices and makes no imputation for non-respondents. Lower than the estimate with imputation
